metrics.layer_count_definition: Nondecreasing receiving-body/root support courses; not hanging-tip bottomZ or slicing layers.

descriptive_pattern_metrics.scope: Occupied8mm/4.8mm source sample andwhole-part palette projectedonto the same normalizedbody. Excludes studs,gaps,chamfers andsupports; realCGmustbeviewed separately.

front.interpretation: Descriptive projected geometry overlap/boundary distance; no aesthetic or mechanical pass threshold

side.interpretation: Descriptive projected geometry overlap/boundary distance; no aesthetic or mechanical pass threshold

painted_feature_region.interpretation: Nearest source palette labels on actual registered visible surfaces. Face pose, color regions and gaps influence this statistic; it does not declare likeness approval.

descriptive_pattern_metrics.region_definition: Tight reference-front bbox of all non-base colorcells plus5pixels; not automatic anatomical landmark detection.
descriptive_pattern_metrics.interpretation: Differences are descriptive. Morepieces are not a validated likeness percentage or mechanical completion.

front.framing_method: Actual native vertex projection, not empty bounding-box corners; center and screen-height normalization per model.
front.normalization_note: The four shapes occupy equal screen height; this image group is NOT a physical size comparison.

three_quarter.framing_method: Actual native vertex projection, not empty bounding-box corners; center and screen-height normalization per model.
three_quarter.normalization_note: The four shapes occupy equal screen height; this image group is NOT a physical size comparison.

limitations_ja: 倍率は実部品数で、寸法倍率ではありません。比較1xは本人不在時の暫定前提です。
完成サイズ増加で元形状の相対格子解像度を上げていますが、色境界は初期C参照で、美観改善の保証ではありません。
放射状分解は説明図。物理的に衝突せず分解できる保証ではありません。下からの順序は公称支持の検査で、保持力は未確認です。
Monaのヒゲは外付け/仮支持台ではなく同色の段付き実部品で本体の複数接点から保持する設計です。現物PLA強度は未測定、印刷時のサポート材不要とは別です。
limitations_en: The multiplier is actual physicalpiececount, not linearsize. The1xbaseline is a provisional creator assumption while the user was unavailable.
Larger fixed-pitch sampling increases relative contour resolution; colors reference initialC. More parts do not guarantee better appearance.
Radial explosion is explanatory, not collision-free physical disassembly. Bottom-up order has nominal support checks, not verified retention.

Mona's whiskers connect to multiple body-root contacts through continuous same-color stepped modules with no external or temporary assembly stands. PhysicalPLAstrength is untested; this does not mean support-free3Dprinting.

whisker_support.method: Real continuous same-color stepped beam/root modules; unchanged body envelope and 8mm root interfaces, no floor stands.

observations_ja: 実寸535.8x439.8x473.8mm、実部品数倍率1.995255。耳・目・口・左右のヒゲが実ブロックで存在し、外付けまたは仮の組立支台は0個。目の縁の非対称な段差、額の大きな段階、頬や口周辺の格子パターンは残り、増加した部品数を外観合格とはしない。
ヒゲ用の一体根元4個に加え、ピンクの下頬用の内部受け1個を実nativeで検証した。後者はMONA-P200-000643 / CT-53C-H048-ebe60418bf-EDGE-C020、53セル・71.8x95.8x4.8mmの通常輪郭系部品で、WR型や支台ではない。
旧21セルの頬受けは実CAD静モーメントmargin-5.1299mmで不合格となり、履歴として保存した。既存の隠れた内部セルを同色の一体受けへ再構成した53セル版で、占有範囲と見える色を保持し、判定1mmを緩めず最小margin9.3516mmを確認した。
4個のヒゲ根元の実CAD一様密度の最小marginは24.5442/18.9735/20.3164/30.3129mm。頬を含む5接続の荷重prefix数は41/42/41/40/48で、ヒゲの実断面は28/28/20/26箇所、真の下面屋根は1.6mmである。
頬は受け側course9→10、ヒゲは22→23、23→24、26→27、27→28。実動画で各周辺工程と根元の挿入を閲覧した。内部受けの接触は外観だけで判断せず、native接触・挿入・全body-first順序の証拠と照合している。
1x1例外62個、長辺15.8mm以上24,749個。全24,811ID/type/color/pose/stepのnative保存・移動再open、135型の実頂点・面、放射分解と復帰、空から全数への保存scene照合が完了した。
現物のPLA・インフィルによる質量分布、保持力、曲げ、クリープ、手のアクセス、転倒は未検証。組立支台なしはスライサーのサポート不要という意味ではなく、物理強度や印刷の承認ではない。
observations_en: Actual24,811 pieces against the fixed12,435 denominator and target24,870, difference-59 within tolerance. Front/three-quarter stills, actual MP4 frames1/18/54/73/108/144, cheek-stage frames79/80/81 and whisker-insertion frames89/90/91/92/93/94 were inspected.

Actual size535.8x439.8x473.8mm and piece-count ratio1.995255. Ears, eyes, mouth and side whiskers are actual bricks with zero external or temporary assembly aids. Uneven eye rims, broad forehead terraces and cheek/mouth lattice patterns remain; increased count is not appearance approval.

Four continuous whisker-root modules and one internal pink lower-cheek anchor were verified in native CAD. The latter is MONA-P200-000643 / CT-53C-H048-ebe60418bf-EDGE-C020, a53-cell71.8x95.8x4.8mm contour-family part, not a WR type or an assembly stand.

The earlier21-cell cheek anchor failed at nominal native static margin-5.1299mm and is retained as failed history. Reconstructing existing hidden cells into the53-cell same-color anchor preserves occupied bounds and visible colors, and achieves minimum margin9.3516mm without lowering the1mm requirement.

The four whisker roots have minimum uniform-CAD-density static margins24.5442/18.9735/20.3164/30.3129mm. The five connections, including the cheek, have41/42/41/40/48 downstream-load prefix checks. Whisker roots have28/28/20/26 actual sections and1.6mm true cavity roofs.

Cheek receiver course9 precedes10; whisker receivers22/23/26/27 precede roots23/24/27/28. Actual movie samples show the surrounding stages and insertion. Hidden contact is not inferred from appearance alone; native contact/insertion and full body-first sequence evidence are also checked.

There are62one-cell exceptions and24,749parts with a long side of at least15.8mm. Native saving and relocation verify all24,811IDs/types/colors/poses/steps. The saved scene matches135native mesh types, radial explode/return transforms and empty-to-full assembly.
Physical PLA/infill mass distribution, retention, bending, creep, hand access and tipping remain untested. No assembly stands does not imply no slicer supports or physical strength/printing approval.
